Playbook:
Description: Password-based SSH login (e.g. OverTheWire Bandit) when username, password, host, and port are given in the challenge brief.
Preferred (single command in the shared shell when ``sshpass`` is available): ``sshpass -p 'PASSWORD' ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -p PORT USER@HOST 'whoami'``
Replace PASSWORD, PORT, USER, HOST from the brief. Append a remote command (``whoami``, ``id``, ``ls``) to verify login in one shot.
Never repeat the same bare ``ssh`` ``command`` after it timed out waiting for a password.
